author: Luke Morrow
text: Thompson did a great job installing a new hot water heater on short notice and was able to track down the one I needed. Would highly recommend and will be my go to plumbing company for any future needs!

author: Kristin Leslie
text: Loved working with Thompson Plumbing! They were professional, honest, and incredibly responsive from start to finish. The quality of their work was outstanding, and they took the time to explain everything clearly and make sure the job was done right. They arrived on time, treated our home with respect, and left everything clean when they were finished. It’s hard to find contractors who combine great customer service with top-notch workmanship, but Thompson Plumbing does exactly that. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, trustworthy plumbing services. Five stars all the way!

author: Tuss Taylor
text: Replaced two old water heaters with a new hybrid heat pump.  Working great and saving on energy.  Super service, quick, reasonable price, and kept things clean. Highly recommend.  Thanks guys…

author: Chelsea Coleman
text: The best plumbers in BG! I trust them with all of my plumbing needs. They answer the phone and are reliable, giving you a fair price and making sure you're well taken care of. I would recommend to anyone!
